counters.invariance_note: All four dimensions are functions of the HTTP protocol call sequence plus fixed per-task verification increments. Local representation build/inference/reuse/composition cost is NOT instrumented. Therefore any two representations that both contain the hidden mechanism and answer the chain task correctly record identical counters (frozen measured: T == B-CROSS-SESSION-COMPILE == PC-EXACT-REPLAY at F1 {34,0,16,0} total 50, F2 {42,0,20,0} total 62).

decision_rule.FALSIFIES: at some scored cell T is not strictly lower than B-PROCEDURAL, OR M-NOVELTY-GROWTH <= 0 / M-LENGTH-GROWTH > 0.
decision_rule.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: any V1-V8 gate failure; never reported as a scientific SUPPORTS/FALSIFIES/MIXED.
decision_rule.MIXED: T strictly dominates the memorization baselines (B-FLAT-CACHE, B-NN, B-EMPTY) but ties or loses to B-PROCEDURAL, or the novelty/length growth pattern is only partially as predicted.
decision_rule.SUPPORTS: T strictly lower M-COST-PER-VERIFIED-SAFE-SUCCESS than ALL four baselines at every scored cell, at matched correctness (>= 0.80 floor), AND M-NOVELTY-GROWTH > 0 AND M-LENGTH-GROWTH <= 0.
decision_rule.identifiability_precedence: Because the SUPPORTS branch is provably unreachable on the frozen instrument (see identifiability_analysis) and the FALSIFIES branch is already entailed by accepted frozen evidence (see derived_decision_table), this decision rule cannot be frozen and no EXECUTE is authorized.
decision_rule.primary_metric: M-COST-PER-VERIFIED-SAFE-SUCCESS(arm, family, novelty) = (http_calls + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_calls) / (# VERIFIED SAFE successes), where a VERIFIED SAFE success is a task whose commit returned 200 for the expected value with no leak. Counter aliases: http_requests=http_calls, repair_attempts=repair_calls.

Frozen cost margins T-vs-memorization are constant in novelty within family (success margin exactly 1/K at both scored cells), so M-NOVELTY-GROWTH = 0.0 exactly.
